reason: The label is actually good, no sweeteners and only fruit sugar, but I'm not ordering a 12-pack of a drink I've never tasted and then walking to a pickup point for it. If I passed one of those partner cafés I might try a can, but I'm not going to look for one.
objection: I can't just grab it in a shop next to my usual drinks, and 649 for twelve cans of something I haven't tried is a blind bet. I also don't know what 4 g of sugar tastes like compared to the Zero stuff I drink now.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at Albert, Billa or the gym or bike shop I already go to, so I can buy one single can and taste it first.
